🚨 **CYBER CRIME & BANK ACCOUNT FREEZE — LEGAL AWARENESS**

Today, cyber-crime complaints can affect anyone. A legitimate bank account may face a **debit freeze, lien, hold or transaction restriction** because a transaction has been linked to a cyber-crime investigation—even when the account holder is not the alleged fraudster.

Recent court decisions, including **Shento Varghese v. Julfikar Husen (Supreme Court, 2024)** and subsequent High Court decisions, have examined the procedure and scope of bank-account freezing and the rights of affected account holders.

If your account is frozen due to a cyber-crime complaint from **Karnataka, Kerala, Telangana or any other State**, it is important to identify the complaint, disputed transaction, amount under lien, investigating authority and applicable legal procedure.

⚖️ **Advocate Sunita Sharma**
Cyber Crime & Criminal Defence Lawyer
10+ Years of Legal Experience

**Don't panic. Preserve your bank statements, KYC and transaction documents and seek appropriate legal advice based on the facts of your case.
comment: A key operational challenge is the gap between quick freezing actions and timely grievance resolution. Banks, investigators and account holders need clearer coordination to prevent genuine customers facing prolonged financial disruption.
